name: Mortgage & Commercial Loan File
description: Financial compliance package for mortgage underwriting, collateral assessment, and credit sanction.

steps.name: Financial & Income Proof
steps.description: Tax returns, payslips, or corporate audited balance sheets.

steps.name: Collateral Appraisal Report
steps.description: Licensed valuer inspection and property valuation.

steps.name: Risk & Underwriting Assessment
steps.description: Credit officer risk rating and underwriting memorandum.

steps.name: Sanction & Approval Letter
steps.description: Credit committee sanction letter with terms and interest rate.

steps.name: Disbursement Agreement & Deed
steps.description: Executed loan agreement and security pledge.

rules.description: Application form must precede income proof.
Income proof must precede collateral appraisal.
Appraisal report must be available before credit sanction.
Sanction letter must precede final loan agreement.
